convert_indices_to_text: convert a list of character indices to a decoded string using an alphabet mapping
mask_random_span_in_text: mask a random contiguous span of characters in a text string using geometric distribution
swap_sentences_randomly: swap adjacent sentences in a list with a given probability
delete_random_characters: delete characters from a sentence with a given probability
delete_random_words: delete random words from a sentence with a given probability
